description: This file contains functions and encoder mappings for converting various Python objects, including Pydantic models, dataclasses, Enums, and standard library types, into JSON-compatible formats. It also handles custom encodings and includes adaptations from Pydantic v1 for FastAPI's JSON serialization process.

methods.name: str isoformat(o: Union[datetime.date, datetime.time])
methods.description: Converts a date or time object to its ISO8601 string representation.

methods.name: Union[int,float] decimal_encoder(dec_value: Decimal)
methods.description: Encodes a Decimal as an int if no exponent is present, otherwise as a float.

methods.name: dict[Callable[[Any],Any],tuple[Any,...]] generate_encoders_by_class_tuples( type_encoder_map: dict[Any, Callable[[Any], Any]], )
methods.description: Creates a reverse mapping from encoder functions to the types they handle.

methods.description: Main function to convert arbitrary Python objects into JSON-serializable formats, supporting Pydantic models, dataclasses, Enums, standard types, and custom encoders.
